as_told.title: Black Vault FOIA on fast walkers denied as exempt

plain: FOIA is a US law that lets anyone ask for government records. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a man named John Greenewald used it to ask for records about "fast walkers", a military term for fast-moving unknown objects, and that NORAD, the command that watches North American skies, said the material was too sensitive to share. A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani says Greenewald, who runs the Black Vault, a website of government records, asked the Space Force and the Department of Defense for papers on both fast walkers and slow walkers, and was turned down under an exemption. The story is told to suggest the military is holding back what it knows about unknown objects.
